signals.label: gp-cost-delay
signals.population: Usual residents aged 15 years and over in private dwellings, within the survey scope, who needed the specified service in the preceding 12 months
signals.estimand: Reported cost-related delay or non-use; cost can coexist with other barriers. State estimate cannot identify an individual or establish the leading barrier.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: specialist-gap
signals.estimand: Specialist-service average, not a specific specialty, referral completion or total pathway cost.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: prescription-cost-delay
signals.population: Usual residents aged 15 years and over in private dwellings, within the survey scope, who needed the specified service in the preceding 12 months
signals.estimand: All prescription medicines, not atorvastatin-specific access.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: gp-fte-remoteness
signals.population: GP FTE supply relative to resident population in each published state and remoteness stratum
signals.estimand: Spatial supply intensity is not travel time, transport accessibility, opening hours or appointment availability. Remoteness strata are not SA4s.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: gp-urgent-under-four-hours
signals.population: Survey-scope residents aged 15 years and over who saw a GP for urgent medical care
signals.estimand: Includes people who obtained urgent GP care; excludes unmet urgent need and is not a real-time appointment feed.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: after-hours-delay
signals.population: Usual residents aged 15 years and over in private dwellings, within the survey scope, who needed the specified service in the preceding 12 months
signals.estimand: All reasons for delay or non-use; not pure capacity, not urgent unsociable-hours telehealth specifically.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: health-system-navigation-difficulty
signals.population: Adults aged 18 years and over represented by ABS 2018 Health Literacy Survey; responding NHS follow-up sample
signals.estimand: 2018 broad health-system navigation, not GP-specific, not a current literacy diagnosis, and not a deficit assigned to a person. No comparable trend asserted.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection

signals.label: telehealth-relationship-lookback
signals.population: Non-referred MBS telehealth eligible-practitioner pathway, subject to MyMedicare alternative and listed exemptions
signals.estimand: Measures a rule parameter observed at retrieval, not the proportion of people eligible, a rule-change trend or individual permission. Urgent unsociable-hours service exception retained.
signals.aggregation: Exact publisher series and geography only; no cross-person or cross-service projection
